title: Tarangam Topic Metadata
description: Canonical metadata schema for one Tarangam study topic. Foundation only: existing Markdown topics are NOT required to carry this metadata yet (see data/topic-metadata.example.json for a valid example). Field shapes mirror the current build conventions: id matches the Markdown filename without extension (m{module}_{sequence}_{slug}), courseCode matches a data/curriculum.json course key and a content/<COURSE>/ directory, module/sequence match the filename convention (00 = module overview, 99 = practice lab).

id.description: Topic id = Markdown filename without .md (e.g. m1_01_random_variables_pmf_cdf).

courseCode.description: Course key as listed in data/curriculum.json and content/ (e.g. GAMAT301).

module.description: Module number from the filename (m{module}_...). Current courses use 1-4.

sequence.description: Topic sequence within the module from the filename (m{module}_{sequence}_...). 0 = module overview, 99 = practice lab.

title.description: Human-readable topic title as rendered on the page.

estimatedMinutes.description: Estimated reading time in minutes (build currently derives ~words/180; this field is the future canonical source).

learningObjectives.description: What the learner will be able to do after this topic. At least one objective.

concepts.description: Key concepts/tags for future search and concept mapping. May be empty.

prerequisites.description: Ids of prerequisite topics (same id format). Empty when the topic stands alone. Prerequisites are NOT yet attached to actual topics.

examRelevance.description: Author-assessed KTU exam weight of the topic.

tags.description: Free-form slug tags for future filtering. May be empty.
